title: The House of Heine Brothers, in Munich
sourceTitle: The House of Heine Brothers, in Munich
author: Anthony Trollope
description: "The House of Heine Brothers, in Munich" by Anthony Trollope is a short story set in the mid-to-late 19th century, during the Victorian era.
longDescription: The story revolves around the modest banking house of Heine Brothers in Munich, which is characterized by its good but unremarkable reputation in the banking world.

authorInfo.bio: Anthony Trollope (1815–1882) is the author of The Warden. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
